delivery.scope: Original signed archives may contain their existing source payloads; this does not create another BusyBox sources/ tree. Fixed original public-key basenames and public-only PEM envelopes, canonical bounded regular inputs, duplicate-key-free receipt JSON, original source/check loaders and copied-byte SHA checks. Output must be fresh. The envelope check is not cryptographic authentication; native verification remains mandatory.

paired_original_dataset_replay.scope: Real original archives/keys/raw receipts/check log copied to a fresh namespace, then native APK verification and complete installed-record binding on those copied archives. Original readonly source roots reused, no source/target/compiler/test execution or package installation. ARM dataset is data here, not native ARM execution. APKv3 SHA256-160 installed-token and APKv2 BusyBox SHA1 control/file semantics remain separate and unchanged.

actual_candidate_runtime_base.scope: Actual candidate target runtime-base builds with the original paired evidence contexts and approved stable feed. Existing installers perform native signature-gated package installs and the bounded BusyBox runtime probe in a disposable builder. A separate read-only/networkless post-build container verifies all four delivered original signed archives and full actual installed DB records, live owned bytes/raw link text/identities/modes, native component/source joins, three installed BusyBox control scripts and four default-trust denials. The source of /bin/sh's referent digest is the separately signed BusyBox regular file, not a hash computed from an untrusted live referent. This is NOT the full application-candidate, native ARM image execution, historical compiler linkage or aggregate acceptance.

negative_controls.cases: Existing output/operator file, input/output-parent aliases, symlinked public key, private/trailing-private key envelopes, wrong public-key basename, copied corruption, oversized or duplicate-key receipt JSON, and rejected original BusyBox source/check validation
negative_controls.dangerous_mutants: Disabling copied-SHA comparison, public-only PEM check or duplicate-key rejection makes eight regression cases fail with DID NOT RAISE

regression_tests.layer: Native AMD64 Alpine source/component/transport/native-builder/SBOM/workflow/classifier and delivery-copy unit subsets, not full backend or whole final image acceptance

remaining: Automated immutable full application-candidate verification using the delivered evidence, native ARM image verification, all owned source/patch/compiler/language/static joins, GNU-wheel integration, frontend/MCP composition and independent unsuppressed advisory/aggregate acceptance. Raw historical check logs still do not prove reproduced tests or compiler linkage. Original corresponding-source proof assets do not change builder patch inputs. Existing OWNED_PENDING set and aggregate RPM dispatch remain unchanged; original strict failures stay retained.
scope: Automated original evidence delivery, not a new runtime provider/signing trust/repository or source waiver. One command is added after the two existing installers in the same candidate RUN; no workflow-step/control-fixture movement. Production Dockerfiles, application/74 pins, FFmpeg flags/patch, gosu/Go, versions, test/numerical goldens, source/advisory gates and publication policy remain unchanged. No merge, publication or deployment.
